设计意图： Mutation of factor_cyclical_pressure_drawdown: replaced 90-day simple moving average of true range with an exponential moving average (span=90) to produce a smoother, more responsive ATR. This preserves the core cyclical pressure mechanism and drawdown sensitivity while potentially improving signal stability and IC through reduced noise. Cross-sectional z-score remains for same-date comparison.

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 high_low：high - low
  2. 计算 high_pc：(high - close.shift(1)).abs()
  3. 计算 low_pc：(low - close.shift(1)).abs()
  4. 计算 true_range：pd.concat([high_low, high_pc, low_pc, axis=1).max(axis=1)
  5. 计算 atr_ema：true_range.ewm(span=90, min_periods=90).mean()
  6. 计算 atr_change：atr_ema / atr_ema.shift(20) - 1
  7. 计算 rolling_max：close.滚动窗口(40, min_periods=20).max()
  8. 计算 drawdown：(rolling_max - close) / rolling_max
  9. 计算 factor：atr_change * (1 + drawdown)
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_cyclical_pressure_drawdown_smoothed(df): df_copy = df.copy() high_low = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"] high_pc = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["close"].shift(1)).abs() low_pc = (df_copy["low"] - df_copy["close"].shift(1)).abs() true_range = pd.concat([high_low, high_pc, low_pc], axis=1).max(axis=1) atr_ema = true_range.ewm(span=90, min_periods=90).mean() atr_change = atr_ema / atr_ema.shift(20) - 1 rolling_max = df_copy["close"].rolling(40, min_periods=20).max() drawdown = (rolling_max - df_copy["close"]) / rolling_max factor = atr_change * (1 + drawdown) "kw">class="kw">return factor.fillna(0).rename("str">'factor_cyclical_pressure_drawdown_smoothed')
